description: Saves the person's answers about the app's encryption in Ploa (nothing reaches Apple until ploa_encryption_declare or the person's Send to Apple). These are the person's statements under US and French export rules: ask them, with what the code suggests (ploa_encryption_get has the questions), and save only what they said. kind: "none" (no encryption, or only Apple's: HTTPS through iOS, the Keychain) | "exempt" (only for what Category 5, Part 2 of the US rules exempts) | "standard" (standard algorithms the app implements itself, like a bundled OpenSSL or libsodium) | "proprietary" | "both". With standard, proprietary or both: france (true when it's on the App Store in France) and description (what the app is and what it uses encryption for). A change after a declaration was made means a new one is made when sent.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_encryption_save
title: Save the export compliance answers
